metadata.task: Organize the apartment by collecting misplaced shoes, books, and magazines, returning each item to its designated location, and inspecting every room before finishing.

plan.goal: Organize the apartment by collecting misplaced shoes, books, and magazines, returning each item to its designated location, and inspecting every room before finishing.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Locate all misplaced items (shoes, books, magazines) in the Living Room and collect them.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at Main Entrance. Misplaced items exist in Living Room.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has collected all misplaced items from the Living Room.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot needs to move from Main Entrance to Living Room.
Robot must perceive the location of misplaced items.
Robot must grasp the shoes.
Robot must grasp the books.
Robot must grasp the magazines.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Transport collected items to their respective storage locations (Corridor for shoes, Bookshelf for books/magazines).
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot holds Shoes, Books, Magazines in Living Room.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has placed Shoes in Corridor and Books/Magazines in Bookshelf.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must move to Corridor to place shoes.
Robot must release shoes at the corridor location.
Robot must move to Bookshelf to place books.
Robot must release books at the bookshelf location.
Robot must release magazines at the bookshelf location.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Inspect all rooms (Living Room, Kitchen, Master Bedroom, Bedroom 2, Bedroom 3, Attached Bathroom, Common Bathroom, Balcony, Corridor) to ensure organization is complete.
checkpoints.entry_state: Items organized. Robot is at Corridor.
checkpoints.exit_state: All rooms inspected and confirmed organized.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must move to Living Room.
Robot must visually inspect the Living Room.
Robot must move to Kitchen.
Robot must visually inspect the Kitchen.
Robot must move to Master Bedroom.
Robot must visually inspect the Master Bedroom.
Robot must move to Bedroom 2.
Robot must visually inspect Bedroom 2.
Robot must move to Bedroom 3.
Robot must visually inspect Bedroom 3.
Robot must move to Attached Bathroom.
Robot must visually inspect Attached Bathroom.
Robot must move to Common Bathroom.
Robot must visually inspect Common Bathroom.
Robot must move to Balcony.
Robot must visually inspect Balcony.
Robot must move to Corridor.
Robot must visually inspect Corridor.

constraints: Robot has single arm only; cannot use two hands simultaneously.
Robot cannot climb stairs; assumes flat floor navigation between
